boards.school_name: South Dakota School of Mines and Technology
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus environments for individual work, group sessions, tutoring, and project-based study.

cards.title: Devereaux Library Student Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Devereaux Library
cards.notes: Start with the library’s student study areas, then use the on-site collections or research assistance to move a project forward.
cards.short_summary: A library-based option with student study spaces and academic collections.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines identifies the renovated Devereaux Library as a location with student study spaces, collections, archives, and a makerspace.
cards.source_title: South Dakota Mines Virtual Tour & Campus Highlights
cards.access_notes: Campus library space; confirm current building access and library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: The Slide Rule Math Help Center
cards.title: The Slide Rule Math Help Center
cards.subtitle: Devereaux Library, third floor
cards.notes: Bring precalculus through Calculus II work, use a rolling glass board, and ask the drop-in faculty and student tutors for help.
cards.short_summary: A math-focused work area with tutors, quiet rooms, laptop stations, and reconfigurable tables.
cards.evidence_claim: The Slide Rule offers drop-in math help, reconfigurable tables, rolling glass boards, laptop stations, and four quiet rooms.
cards.source_title: The Slide Rule Math Help Center
cards.access_notes: Located in the southeast corner of Devereaux Library’s third floor. Posted hours: Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; Fri 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; no appointment needed.

cards.title: Mines Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Devereaux Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use this project-oriented setting when coursework benefits from tools, materials, and a collaborative art-and-engineering environment.
cards.short_summary: A library makerspace for class projects, research, and creative exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines describes the third-floor library Makerspace as a collaboration hub equipped for class projects, research, and personal exploration.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of the library; check with the Makerspace for current availability and equipment-use guidance.

cards.entity_name: Vanderboom Office of Student Success Study Spaces
cards.title: Vanderboom Office of Student Success Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Devereaux Library
cards.notes: Pair a study session with tutoring or advising nearby, using the office’s documented collaboration and study areas for course work.
cards.short_summary: Study and collaboration space alongside tutoring, advising, and academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Vanderboom Office of Student Success in Devereaux Library includes collaboration and study spaces, tutoring, advising, and testing services.
cards.source_title: Mines Dedicates Vanderboom Office of Student Success
cards.access_notes: Located within Devereaux Library; service and space availability may vary, so check with the Office of Student Success.

cards.title: The Malone Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Tiospaye Center, 137 Devereaux Library
cards.notes: Use the designated quiet or group room and its whiteboard space for focused work; contact Tiospaye for current eligibility details.
cards.short_summary: Two named study-room modes—quiet and group—within the Tiospaye program space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tiospaye space at 137 Devereaux Library includes 24/7 Quiet Study and Group Study Rooms and ample whiteboard space.
cards.access_notes: Located at 137 Devereaux Library. The page identifies the space with the Tiospaye program; contact the program for access details.

cards.title: PC Commons Study Space
cards.subtitle: Connected to Connolly and Palmerton Halls
cards.notes: Set up at the shared gathering area when you want a study setting with lounge furniture, a kitchenette, and nearby residence halls.
cards.short_summary: A residence-life gathering space that explicitly includes study space.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines describes PC Commons as a large gathering space with study space, TVs, lounge furniture, and a kitchenette.
cards.access_notes: Connected to Connolly and Palmerton Halls; access is associated with residence life, so confirm guest and resident access rules.

cards.title: Howard Peterson Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Howard Peterson Hall
cards.notes: Choose one of the hall’s two study rooms for a contained study session, with kitchens and smaller lounges elsewhere in the building.
cards.short_summary: Two documented study rooms inside a first- and second-year residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard Peterson Hall has various gathering spaces, including two study rooms, two kitchens, and small lounges.
cards.access_notes: Residence-hall space for Peterson residents; verify guest access and any room-use procedures with Residence Life.

cards.title: Placer Hall Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Placer Hall
cards.notes: Plan a shared problem set or project meeting in Placer’s group-study inventory, which includes one large and three small rooms.
cards.short_summary: A suite-style residence hall with four documented group study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Placer Hall provides one large group study room and three small group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Located in Placer Hall and intended within residence life; confirm resident access and any room-use process before relying on it.

cards.entity_name: Rocker Square I Group Study Room
cards.title: Rocker Square I Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Rocker Square I Apartments
cards.notes: Use the apartment building’s designated group study room for collaborative coursework, then check local residence-life guidance for availability.
cards.short_summary: A named group-study option in the Rocker Square I apartment building.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines states that Rocker Square I features a group study room.
cards.access_notes: Located in Rocker Square I; this is residence-hall space, so confirm resident and guest access with Residence Life.

cards.title: Surbeck Center Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Surbeck Center
cards.notes: Use the student-center study areas for coursework between campus activities, and check the building’s schedule if you need a meeting room.
cards.short_summary: Study areas in the campus student-life center alongside meeting rooms and services.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines’ institutional profile lists study areas and meeting rooms among the Surbeck Center’s student-life spaces.
cards.access_notes: The Surbeck Center is primarily for student use; meeting rooms and public areas may be scheduled, so verify availability before group work.
